title: I made an auto-battler where every unit is a real bug species. Free in the browser, would love feedback
author: FabulusGames
selftext:
TypeScript, React, Three.js, Cloudflare Workers/Durable Objects, and Supabase. I use Claude Code for coding, Codex for art, and Claude+Blender for 3D models. 

You can play for free at [BugTeamBattles.com](http://bugteambattles.com/)

it is NOT finished.

This is a passion project I've thrown together in my very limited free time that started with "let's just see if this is even possible, just for fun" and turned into a little hobby. This is not an attempt at a cash grab, I included in game currency and cosmetics with the hope it could bring in enough money to at least pay for itself one day, but there will be plenty of cosmetics that don't require real money to purchase/unlock and playing the game will always be free.

Features:

* Sandbox, duos, ranked, normal, tutorial, solo, and custom game modes
* no account needed to play with friends and offline play for non-matchmaking modes
* a scouting tooltip that tells you about the opponent's board at a glance
* item placement and tracking in the team builder
* ability to add/remove units from the team builder at the shop, and ability to prevent certain units from being rerolled
* fully 3D gameplay that runs directly in your browser on desktop and mobile, no download required

Caveats/things that still need a lot of work:

* SOUND DESIGN. The game sounds pretty terrible right now. I have a workflow that uses REAPER at the moment but I am still not making great progress. Any advice or suggestions for sound design would be much appreciated.
* many units (around half) still need upgraded art and abilities
* the units/traits are NOT balanced. I am holding off on fine tuning balance until I get all of the traits and unit abilities locked in
* need to add a lot more augments
* a lot of items need new art
* the list is basically endless, so I will leave it there for now

I would really appreciate any and all feedback! Criticism, slop accusations, ideas for abilities/traits/augments/QOL improvements, you name it, happy to hear it.

If you are interested in beta testing, let me know your account name and I can give you beta tester status, which adds a feedback form in game that you can quickly fill out as you play.

comments.author: SeaweedOk9985
comments.body: Very cool, I will give it a go later. Clearly heavily inspired by TFT with your own spin. Would be cool to see if you could come up with some Unique / new ideas to the formulae beyond the bugs. For example the star / level up system for units could be different stages of a bugs development

replies.author: FabulusGames
replies.body: Thanks for checking it out! Yes, that is an interesting idea that I am currently workshopping
